run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum sum of pairs with difference less than K in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct maximum sum pair calculation
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a binary search instead of linear scan for pair matching
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming approach for finding maximum sum pairs with specific difference
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases when array has fewer than two elements or all differences exceed K
